name: Elin Watts
life: Elin used to be the student who gave up the solo, the prize or the last bit of cake to prove how little she needed. A generous pupil saying everything is fine is the pupil she checks on in the corridor. Thursday often includes a stop at Maré Coffee, where Elin likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: He thinks giving up the audition proves he is decent. I recognize that bargain from my own adolescence. I asked him to name one decent thing he can do and still play.
appearance: Elin is easy to recognize by short black hair swept back and a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones. Usually dressed in a moss-green cardigan with a pair of reading glasses in a cloth sleeve, Elin gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in when listening.
personality: Elin has a strong competitive streak and a very soft spot for the person finishing last. A prize tastes better when everybody had enough time to enter.
agenda: To help Cory keep an opportunity while doing right by the old owner.
family: Kai Day is Elin’s cousin. Elin makes room at the table. Kai brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The dead man's tab*, Kai says, “I sold him pills. I won't call the debt friendship just because he died.”
connections: Nia Oak. They give the teenager somewhere quiet to make a call without having to surrender the audition.
